config.hypothesis: Domain-size pooling may improve sparse-photo constraints and held-out quality at additional CPU cost; test full pipeline without affine shape adaptation.
config.gate: Require full registration, identical held-out names, no scene-level PSNR/SSIM regression across two repeats before any default change; report runtime trade-off.
config.cache: Fresh SfM database per run; OS disk cache not purged; GPU training serial.
